text_excerpt: CASTR Alliance Skip to content Menu Home Mission Services Team News Testimonials Contact |Accelerating medical discovery | Advancing veterinary care CASTR: Companion Animal Studies for Translational Research Ongoing Studies Contact What we do CASTR Alliance aims to advance human and veterinary medicine by facilitating the discovery of innovative treatments through the management of high-quality veterinary clinical studies and collaboration with industry leaders and veterinary hospitals. We provide turnkey management of sponsored veterinary clinical studies to pharmaceutical and medical device development teams worldwide. We partner with state-of-the-art veterinary specialty and referral hospitals throughout the Pacific Northwest and beyond to enroll patients on sponsored clinical studies. We manage sponsored clinical trials that abide by Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards for veterinary studies and are designed to ensure the collection of high-quality data.
